components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action of a step, in ink as on a station sign.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-ink, #111418); color: var(--color-panel, #fff); height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 14px 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), opacity 160ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #111418); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stations
components.description: The steps as stations on the line: done, current (you are here), ahead.
components.html:
✓Prepare
2Pick a root
3Run
components.css: .ds-line { position: relative; background: #0b3d91; color: #fff; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; font: 14px 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-line::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 25.5px; top: 24px; bottom: 24px; width: 3px; background: #c9d6ee; } .ds-stop { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 0; } .ds-st { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-done { background: #fff; color: #0b3d91; } .ds-here { background: #d7263d; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff; } .ds-ahead { background: #0b3d91; color: #c9d6ee; border: 2px solid #8fa6d1; }

components.name: View Tool
components.description: A labelled tool in the plot's view tools group; filled while on or open.
components.css: .ds-tools { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 112px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-panel, #fff); } .ds-tool { height: 32px; text-align: left; padding: 0 10px 0 8px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #111418); font: 14px 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tool:hover, .ds-tool[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-panel-raised, #f1f3f6); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #111418); }

components.description: Selects and the gene search: raised tone, no border.

narrative.overview: A trajectory reads like a metro map. You are at one station, the line runs on to the next, and lines branch where lineages split. The sidebar is the line itself: a deep-blue band the four steps (Prepare, Pick a root, Run, Inspect) sit on as stations, with a red "you are here" on the step in hand. Everything else is a working screen in the transit authority's register: plain white or night-navy sheets, one legible sans, data set in a mono, and nothing decorative.
keyCharacteristics: A coloured shell: the deep-blue sidebar carries the steps as stations on one line.
One red, "you are here", and only for where you are.
White or night-navy sheets on a quiet stage; depth from tone, not shadow.
Atkinson Hyperlegible throughout, mono for numbers, ids and data.
Scientific data colours, never restyled to match the world.

rules.name: The You-Are-Here Rule
rules.body: Red marks where you are and nothing else: the root, the focused lineage, the current step. It is never a button, a data colour, an error colour or decoration.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: There is one shadow and it means "floats over the plot". Nothing inside a sheet gets its own.

rules.name: The Line Rule
rules.body: Inside the sidebar the usual tokens point at the shell's blues (.shell in web/src/index.css), so any control placed there takes the line's colours without its own styling. Never hand-colour a sidebar control.

rules.name: The Data Stays Data Rule
rules.body: Cells are coloured by viridis (continuous) and an Okabe-Ito-based categorical set, colour-blind-safe. The theme never restyles them; near-reds are ordered last so no category reads as the red.

rules.name: The Mono Is Measurement Rule
rules.body: Mono is for numbers, ids and data only, never as a "technical" costume for prose.

dos: Do put the red only where the user is: root, focused lineage, current step.
Do add sidebar controls with the ordinary tokens and let .shell re-point them.
Do keep numbers, ids and thresholds in the mono.
Do keep a failure visible when folding detail (state the count in the fold's summary).
Do check every new text pair for WCAG AA in both themes.
donts: Don't use red for errors or failed checks; they keep their icon and words in ink.
Don't recolour cells to match the theme; data colours are scientific choices.
Don't use Ink Faint for text anyone has to read; it is for disabled controls.
Don't add a second shadow; inside sheets, use the raised tone.
Don't make a button red; primary buttons are ink.
